title: exercise-stress-misclassification: code for "Revealing Exercise-Induced Misclassification in Wearable Stress Detection for Automated Insulin Delivery"
description: Analysis code, segment index, hashed pre-specified rules and trial log for a pre-registered re-evaluation of stress and exercise recognition from Empatica E4 wrist signals (PhysioNet dataset doi:10.13026/he0v-tf17), with an external test on WESAD. Raw data are not redistributed. Pre-registration: https://osf.io/swge8. This research was financially supported by the Deanship of Scientific Research and Graduate Studies at King Khalid University under research grant number (R.G.P.2/191/47).
